academy_awards_triple_nominees.html

People nominated at all three of the 68th, 70th and 74th Academy Awards
Marisol Quennell (Best Original Score) – 68th: The Harbor Clock – 70th: Salt and Iron – 74th: The Long Orchard (won at the 70th for Salt and Iron)
Desmond Ashcombe (Best Sound) – 68th: Northern Lanterns – 70th: The Glass Harbor – 74th: Copperfield Road
Ines Varkonyi (Best Actress) – 68th: A Season in Porto – 70th: The Paper Crown – 74th: Quiet Waters of Kells
Rupert Halloway (Best Makeup) – 68th: Stone Meridian – 70th: The Last Ferry to Arran – 74th: An Hour Past Blue
Celeste Marrow (Best Film Editing) – 68th: The Night Garden of Vey – 70th: Iron Bells – 74th: The Cartographer's Daughter

Considering the complete winners-and-nominees lists for the 68th, 70th, and 74th Academy Awards, identify every person who was nominated at all three ceremonies. For each person, give at least one nominated work from each ceremony. Also determine whether each person won at any of those three ceremonies; if so, identify the ceremony, work, and award.
